name: Ca bong kho tieu
nameVi: Cá bống sông Trà kho tiêu
summary: Cá bống sông Trà kho tiêu is the pepper braise. Vietnam Airlines uses green pepper, fish sauce, and caramel. ZaloPay adds fresh chili. The Cẩm Thành ward article’s phrase is a salty-sweet braise, printed separately.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the finished braise salty-sweet, with the heat of pepper and a little smoke. ZaloPay calls it đậm đà and names green pepper, fish sauce, and fresh chili. The ward article’s words are rim mặn ngọt, and that line is not this dry-box braise.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: the fish lives in the lower Trà Khúc, small, with firm fragrant meat. Braise it slowly with green pepper, fish sauce, and caramel until the seasoning sits in the meat and the sauce thickens. Eat it with hot rice.
ZaloPay: braise with green pepper, fish sauce, and fresh chili, and eat it with hot rice, including on rainy days. It also says the braise is packed in a jar as a gift.
The Nghĩa Hành commune article names bánh phồng and cơm rang made from cá bống sông Trà and does not describe either one.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The Trà Khúc, on the Cẩm Thành ward article and on Vietnam Airlines. Neither prints a restaurant street for the braise.
Nghĩa Hành is the commune that names the cracker and the fried rice. It is not a city stall.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 160,000 VND for 300 g of the pepper braise. ZaloPay and the ward article printed no price.
seoTitle: Ca bong kho tieu — pepper braise from the Tra Khuc
seoDescription: Cá bống sông Trà braised with green pepper. Vietnam Airlines prints 160,000 VND for 300 g. ZaloPay adds chili. The hour is Check on arrival.
